-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem ciTracked_step (c : CfgM) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (n : Nat) (S : GMap w64 Unit) (Hn : ciTracked
    c prs n) (HS : (ciSets c)[n]? = some S) (Hall : ∀ (k : w64), (S !! k).isSome = true → (prs !!
    k).isSome = true) : ciTracked c prs (n + 1)

theorem ciTracked_all (c : CfgM) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (H : ciTracked c prs 3) (k : w64) (Hk :
    ciMember c k) : (prs !! k).isSome = true

def ciSets (c : CfgM) : List (GMap w64 Unit) :=
  [c.incoming ∪ c.outgoing, c.learners, c.learnersNext]

def ciTracked (c : CfgM) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (S : GMap w64 Unit) (k : w64),
    j < n → (ciSets c)[j]? = some S → (S !! k).isSome = true → (prs !! k).isSome = true

    (dqc dqm dqp : DFrac),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        (isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.confchange ∗
            ownCfgCC cfg dqc c ∗ ownMap trk dqm prs ∗ [∗map] pr;pv ∈ prs;pvs, typedPointsto pr pv dqp) -∗
          (▷
              ∀ err,
                ownCfgCC cfg dqc c ∗

                        ⌜err = GoInterface.nil ↔ CfgInv { cfg := c, prs := flagsOf pvs }⌝ -∗
                  Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
            WP (((intoVal (functions confchange.checkInvariants [])) (intoVal cfg)) (intoVal trk)) {{ Φ }}

theorem ci_close [package_sem : Assumptions] (cfg : tracker.Config) (c : CfgM) (vin vout : Loc) (dqc
    : DFrac) (Harr : cfg.Voters'.arr = [vin, vout]) (Hal : cfg.AutoLeave' = c.autoLeave) (Hinnn :
    vin ≠ map.nil) (Hcout : vout = map.nil ∨ c.outgoing ≠ ∅) (Hcln : cfg.LearnersNext' = map.nil ∨
    c.learnersNext ≠ ∅) (Hcl : cfg.Learners' = map.nil ∨ c.learners ≠ ∅) : ⊢ ownIdsetQ vin dqc
    c.incoming -∗ ownIdsetQ vout dqc c.outgoing -∗ ownIdsetQ cfg.Learners' dqc c.learners -∗
    ownIdsetQ cfg.LearnersNext' dqc c.learnersNext -∗ ownCfgCC cfg dqc c

def ciMember (c : CfgM) (k : w64) : Prop :=
  k ∈ c.incoming ∨ k ∈ c.outgoing ∨ k ∈ c.learners ∨ k ∈ c.learnersNext

theorem ciSets_member (c : CfgM) (n : Nat) (S : GMap w64 Unit) (k : w64) (HS : (ciSets c)[n]? = some
    S) (Hk : (S !! k).isSome = true) : ciMember c k

theorem ci_err {P : Prop} (e : GoInterfaceOk) (H : ¬P) : GoInterface.ok e = GoInterface.nil ↔ P
